test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

One of my friends __is gone__ to Goa for a holiday.
solution:
The correct answer is **has gone**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Has gone'** should be used here in place of **'**is gone'
